course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose, X is a student at Y university. X does odd jobs to supplement his income. Job requests come every 5 days on the average, but the time between requests is exponential. The time for completing a job is also exponential with mean 4 days. Answer the following questions:
i) What is the probability that X will be out of jobs?
ii) If X gets about \$50 a job, what is his average monthly income?
iii) If at the end of the semester, X decides to subcontract on the outstanding jobs at \$40 each. How much, on average, should he expect to earn?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
